narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms developed in the afternoon to evening hours on September 21st. There was one isolated flooding report in Davidson County.
ev: Several roads were flooded in West Nashville including Charlotte Pike, 21st Avenue, and the I-440 exit ramp at West End Avenue.
